memory_bridge: The family’s gold heirloom retrieves kin → On キン and its Friday square; the coins made from that gold retrieve standalone money 金（かね）.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 金曜日（きんようび）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: All the kin gather around the gold heirloom on Friday; kin → キン in 金曜日（きんようび）.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 金（かね）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The gold plates become clinking coins in a cash drawer; that money is simply 金（かね）, Kun かね.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 一定 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The straight foot points to one roof and a judge declares 一定（citation yī dìng）, “certainly”; the gavel and dìng both drop with finality. In ordinary speech, 一 surfaces as yí before fourth-tone dìng.
